source_title: Arizona Secretary of State — 2018 official U.S. Senate canvass
source_notes: 2018 regular Arizona U.S. Senate election. All 10 official named candidates, including write-ins, and all 15 county records reconcile to the printed statewide canvass totals. The official PDF host returned 403; retained indexed official table text and a reviewed CSV provide the canvass reference. Checksums identify retained text/CSV, not an unavailable original PDF binary. The older OpenElections copy omits Jeff Pearce in Mohave; the official canvass explicitly reports 1. Its absence was not converted to zero. Existing event turnout is shared.
